title: In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.16, a user who does not hold the "admin" or…
description: A vulnerability in Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.16 allows non-admin and non-power users to execute arbitrary Search Processing Language (SPL) searches with elevated privileges via data model acceleration. This occurs because Splunk Enterprise does not properly sanitize user-supplied data model acceleration values before incorporating them into summarization searches.
